equations_and_footnotes.nfe_formula: NFE (%) = 100 - Ash (%) - Crude Fiber (%) - Ether Extract (%) - Crude Protein (%)

swine_from_de.note: Indonesian p.20 contained OCR/print typo 0.92 and integer 5; English p.34 confirms 0.96 - 0.00202 * CP%.

cattle_neg_garrett_1977.note: English p.34 gives correct coefficients +0.1275*ME^3 and -0.006787*ME^4 (Indonesian p.20 printed typo +0.175 and +0.006787).

cattle_nel_moe_tyrrell_1976.note: English p.34 confirms leading minus sign (-0.12); Indonesian p.20 dropped the minus sign.

international_iu_standards.1_IU_vitamin_A: 1 USP unit = 0.344 ug all-trans vitamin A acetate = 0.300 ug all-trans vitamin A alcohol = 0.550 ug vitamin A palmitate
international_iu_standards.1_IU_from_carotene_rat: 0.6 ug beta-carotene; 1.0 mg beta-carotene = 1667 IU vitamin A (rat standard)

source_errata.issue: Printed DM% for As-Fed is 1.% (likely printer drop from ~86.%); computerized DM-basis columns on row 0434 are ~100x inflated (Ash 1127.9%, CP 534.9%). Preserved verbatim in archive; normalized safely in production TS library.
Printed CF% shows 99.5% AF / 115.7% DM (printer decimal shift from ~9.95% / 11.57%). Preserved verbatim in archive; corrected in production TS library using AFprox check.
Printed Cu (mg/kg) shows 54.33 AF / 73.02 DM despite 20% DM. Preserved verbatim.
Printed Zn (mg/kg) shows 20.70 AF / 31.63 DM at 92% DM. Preserved verbatim.
Printed p.125 placed 98.00 / 00.00 in Biotin column (printer format-wrap from Choline 3698. / 4300.). Preserved in archive with note.
Printed Zn (mg/kg) shows 10.11+ AF / 28.04+ DM at 86% DM. Preserved verbatim.
Printed NaF Sodium % shows smudge E4.75 (54.75% Na per NaF stoichiometry).
